_comment: Ticket 08 AC#3: the 2 rooms x 10 listeners smoke ramp against AWS staging.
24 bots total = 2 rooms x (2 speakers + 10 listeners).
target.url MUST be the raw instance IP, never audio.staging.flyliveapp.com --
src/guard.mjs deny-lists the whole *.flyliveapp.com suffix, so the staging
DNS name is REFUSED by design. Re-derive the IP before each campaign:
fleet.userIdBase is DELIBERATELY ABSENT. run.mjs:97 reads
and `+` binds tighter than `??`, so SETTING the field pins every bot in the
fleet to one identical JWT id. Omitting it is what gives each bot a unique
id (9000001, 9000002, ...). Do not add it back.
holdSeconds is 120: this is a smoke, not a capacity measurement. run.mjs will
warn that <600s cannot certify a level -- that warning is correct and expected.
Ticket 10's saturation ramps are the runs that need >=600s holds.
